concurrent_jobs.method: intervals written by the job wrapper into the status directory: start before this job's end and end after its start (or no end yet)

generation.decoder: argmax loop task2.kv_cache_ops.greedy_decode; the last generated token is not fed back

config.method_order_rule: task2.kv_cache_ops.METHODS rotated left by (prompt_index mod 6); prompt_index = rank of the id
config.prompt_format: one user message with the supplied chat template (default system message), add_generation_prompt=True; context = tokens before the line QUESTION_BEGIN
config.scorer: task2-kv-scorer-v1: first match of (?<!\d)\d{5}(?!\d) in the generated text equals the gold code; no match is incorrect and flagged
